description: Up to 100 Reddit accounts in one call, by t2_ fullname (the `author_info.fullname` every post and comment result carries): a `users` list (name, created, link, comment and total karma, profile image, NSFW profile flag), `requested`, `returned`, and `missing` (deleted, suspended or nonexistent accounts). Reddit has no batch read by username, so this takes ids only. One read at the standard read price. Example: ids='t2_16b0vi,t2_abc12'.

ids.description: Comma-separated t2_ account fullnames, up to 100. The t2_ prefix is required.

name: reddit_users_batch
title: Get Users by ID
